warning.titlePre: Mercedes Citan 109 CDI Injector & EGR Issues
paragraphs: If your Citan 109 CDI is a pre-2021 model with the K9K diesel engine — that's the W415 generation — injector failure and EGR clogging is a well-documented pattern on this Renault-sourced engine, recognised across the Mercedes commercial vehicle range. We replace injectors, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every K9K rebuild.

The newer W420 generation uses different engines — OM607 or OM608 — which are not independently confirmed to share the same pattern. We'll confirm your exact engine code by registration before any work begins.
warning.source: Source: general Renault/Mercedes commercial vehicle consensus, per VRF-mercedes-citan.md. OM607/OM608 (W420) not independently confirmed
